name: [TemperPaw] Error Rate Spike
message:
TemperPaw error rate exceeds 10% over the last 15 minutes.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Request Latency Spike (P95)
message:
TemperPaw P95 request latency exceeds 5 seconds.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] No Traffic
message:
No HTTP requests received by TemperPaw in 15 minutes. Platform may be down.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Indexed Entities Drop
message:
No indexed entities in TemperPaw's query plane. Platform may have lost discoverable state.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Startup Time Regression
message:
TemperPaw startup time to healthy exceeds 120s over the last 15 minutes.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] OS App Reconcile Regression
message:
TemperPaw OS app reconcile exceeds 60s during startup.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Required WASM Load Failures
message:
Required TemperPaw WASM modules failed to load in the last 15 minutes.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Session Memory Budget Exceeded
message:
TemperPaw sessions exceeded the bounded context memory budget in the last 15 minutes.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Dispatch Retry Budget Exhausted
message:
Dispatch retry budget exhausted (ADR-0048) — sustained transient failures indicate mailbox saturation or a stuck actor.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Permanent Actor Failures
message:
Permanent actor failures elevated — check for panics, init failures, or restart-exceeded conditions.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Mailbox Saturation (mailbox_full spike)
message:
Actor mailboxes refusing messages — tune admission control caps (ADR-0051) or investigate head-of-line blocking.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Abnormal State Timeout Firing
message:
State timeout firing unusually often for one or more (entity_type, state) combos. Likely causes: after_seconds too tight, or sessions are genuinely stuck.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Excessive Overdue Timers on Replay
message:
Many scheduled-action timers missed their deadline across a server restart window. Review deploy cadence or investigate replay lag.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Spec Liveness Violation
message:
A spec was loaded with uncovered non-terminal states (ADR-0050). Production should never boot with violations once TEMPER_LIVENESS_ENFORCE=true — investigate immediately.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Admission Deferred Spike
message:
Admission control is returning 503 Deferred to callers. Investigate: either bump the cap via /_admin/admission/ or diagnose sustained overload.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Admission Wait p99 Regression
message:
P99 admission queue wait exceeds 5s — caps likely too tight relative to offered load.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Mailbox Near Capacity
message:
One or more entity-type mailboxes are averaging above 80% capacity. Head-of-line blocking risk — tune admission caps (ADR-0051).

@slack-temperpaw-alerts

name: [TemperPaw] Unexpected Mailbox Drops (post-P4)
message:
Mailbox-full drops are occurring even with admission control in place. Caps may be set above safe concurrency — reduce, or investigate slow actor consumers.

@slack-temperpaw-alerts
